verdict.rationale: cubic offers a one-click "Fix with cubic" button on review findings. A coding agent then generates the fix and pushes it to the PR branch, so the developer gets a one-click apply outcome. This is an asynchronous agent-generated commit, though, not a suggested diff shown inline in the review comment that you can inspect and commit directly. Missing for 10: evidence that comments contain visible committable suggestion blocks (e.g. GitHub suggested changes), preview of the diff before applying, independent or hands-on corroboration.
